findings.title: Handlebars.js Critical RCE via AST Type Confusion
findings.description: Multiple critical JavaScript injection vulnerabilities via AST type confusion allowing remote code execution

findings.title: Express Dependency Vulnerability (qs DoS)
findings.description: Remotely triggerable DoS via malformed query strings in qs.stringify()

findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-Step Sequence DoS
findings.description: Process hang and memory exhaustion via pathological regex patterns

findings.title: uuid Buffer Bounds Check Missing
findings.description: Buffer overflow in uuid v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided
findings.fix: Upgrade to uuid>=11.1.1 or audit code for v3/v5/v6 usage
findings.cross_ref: TheGuardians - Code audit if v3/v5/v6 used

findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in .map Handling
findings.description: Path traversal vulnerability in optimized deps .map handling (dev-time only)

findings.title: esbuild Development Server CORS Bypass
findings.description: Development server allows CORS bypass to send requests and read responses (dev-time only)

findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style> Tag
findings.description: XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify output (dev-time build)

findings.title: ws Uninitialized Memory Disclosure
findings.description: Uninitialized memory disclosure in WebSocket implementation (dev-time only)

findings.title: vitest Multiple Transitive Vulnerabilities
findings.description: Inherits multiple vulnerabilities from transitive dependencies

findings.title: Express Body Parser Moderate Vulnerability
findings.description: Inherits qs vulnerability (P2 root cause already listed as DEP-002)

findings.title: pino Major Version Gap
findings.description: 2 major versions behind; may miss security patches in v9 and v10
findings.fix: npm update pino (requires testing for log format changes)

findings.title: React Major Version Gap
findings.description: 1 major version behind; React 19 introduces new hooks and patterns
findings.fix: npm update react react-dom (requires component testing)

findings.title: Multiple Deprecation Warnings
findings.description: Packages in maintenance mode or with memory leaks; not security-critical but warrant future updates

supply_chain_assessment.single_maintainer_packages: unknown (would require npm registry API calls)

immediate_actions: npm update ts-jest (fixes DEP-001: handlebars RCE)
npm update express (fixes DEP-002, DEP-003, DEP-010)
npm update uuid (fixes DEP-004 if v3/v5/v6 used)
npm update vite vitest (fixes DEP-005, DEP-006, DEP-008, DEP-009)
testing_required: Run full test suite after backend updates
Run E2E tests after frontend build tool updates
Verify React component compatibility after React 19 upgrade

Schedule express, uuid updates for this sprint
